title: The merge tool's review_state counts a guard or check change as done only after round 3 and its net-value test
why: Coordinator 13:15 CST Nov 8: review_state counts a guard change as done when its round 2 passes. #2209 (lane review-record-before-any-push) stopped there, but owner items 359 b and 402 a need rounds 1-3 with the net-value test for any guard or check change. No step owned review_state's round count (triage grep: process-held-end-to-end, record-replacement-pr-rounds and review-rounds-rework touch review_state for other reasons). Related: merge-guard-flag-from-paths, which sets the `Guard or check` field this count depends on.
note: Sighting (lane other-checkout-cp-own, session_013NEJL3R2CBFavz7grtbJY8, 13:31 CST Nov 8): the lane handed #2125 and #2213 to runner 8 after a round-2 PASS on a guard change; runner 8 caught it and round 3 runs on both. Proposed check, folded here instead of a new step guard-record-needs-round-3: `merge --review-record` with `--guard yes` refuses a record with no round 3 and a net value of `not owed`; the remedy cites owner item 402 a. Sighting (coordinator 13:30 CST Nov 8): lane open-asks-listed-at-wake (session_013NEJL4DA5XcyP7kY5qkXP5, Sonnet) called round 3 "not owed" on a check change. Coordinator 14:30 CST Nov 8: #2252 with runner 8 at head 0d791c45e, Merge after #1353. Sighting (coordinator 14:58 CST Nov 8): #2280 re-handed with rounds 1-3 at its live head; its proposed guard (refuse a Guard-yes record with no round 3) is this step's #2252. Coordinator 15:39 CST Nov 8: routed to lane session_013NEJL33qiuVEZBa4bipxtY. Sighting (lane guard-fix-check-sonnet, #1572 round 1): merge.py's done path reads a guard-yes record as done after a FAIL, a fix check PASS and "not owed". Coordinator 15:42 CST Nov 8: the 15:39 lane (session_013NEJL33qiuVEZBa4bipxtY) was a duplicate and is dropped. #2252 (Merge after #1353, lane session_013NEJKzfKKumSC9zYS7gonr from its footer) carries the step; the write-side refusal half is dropped, because review_state is the one home. Note: rule roles-review-cap-three does not say a guard change cannot finish on a round 1 or 2 PASS; an edit there needs the owner's words.
